root_cause: The checkboxes module fails to load because the ES module import does not match the module's exports (neither named nor default), preventing the exclusive checkbox behavior from initializing.
repair_strategy: Replace the failing module import with an inline script that implements exclusive checkbox behavior directly, ensuring keyboard-operable exclusive choice for both symptoms and contact groups.

edits.after:
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  // Exclusive checkbox behavior for data-checkbox-exclusive and data-checkbox-exclusive-group
  document.querySelectorAll('input[data-checkbox-exclusive]').forEach(function(exclusiveCheckbox) {
    exclusiveCheckbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (this.checked) {
        var group = this.getAttribute('data-checkbox-exclusive-group');
        if (group) {
          document.querySelectorAll('input[data-checkbox-exclusive-group="' + group + '"]:not([data-checkbox-exclusive])').forEach(function(cb) {
            cb.checked = false;
            cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
          });
        }
      }
    });
  });
  // Uncheck exclusive when a non-exclusive in same group is checked
  document.querySelectorAll('input[data-checkbox-exclusive-group]:not([data-checkbox-exclusive])').forEach(function(cb) {
    cb.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (this.checked) {
        var group = this.getAttribute('data-checkbox-exclusive-group');
        document.querySelectorAll('input[data-checkbox-exclusive][data-checkbox-exclusive-group="' + group + '"]').forEach(function(excl) {
          excl.checked = false;
          excl.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        });
      }
    });
  });
});
</script>

expected_accessibility_effect: Selecting the exclusive 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' checkbox will now clear any previously selected symptom checkboxes, providing correct keyboard-operated exclusive choice behavior and satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (keyboard) and 4.1.2 (name, role, value).
functional_risks: Inline script may not cover all edge cases of the original module (e.g., dynamic groups, nested forms).
If the original module provides additional enhancements (e.g., ARIA attributes), they will be missing.
verification_requirements: After applying the edit, executing the journey steps (tick cough, tick fever, then tick 'no symptoms') should result in symptoms[cough] and symptoms[fever] being cleared (value []).
The regression guard for choosing 'Do not contact me' after ticking a contact method should pass (contact value ['none']).
All existing functional checks and success criteria should remain satisfied.
